components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of the city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a hyphen, and a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'PAR-FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an existing same-household owner is present; null otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'PAR-SMI-0007-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'PAR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3: starts at 1, plus 1 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

All 3 tests pass (`mvnw test` is green, `BUILD SUCCESS`). The `verify` step additionally runs a JaCoCo coverage gate that fails at **0.18 line coverage vs. an expected 0.85** — but that's a pre-existing, project-wide condition: the entire test tree contains only this one `AcceptanceTest` (3 tests exercising the create-owner path), so overall coverage was always far below 0.85 regardless of this change. ## Summary of changes

The feature: an optional 4-digit `postcode`, validated only when present against the city's region range (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099; unknown regions accept any 4 digits), stored and returned.

Each piece landed in the layer that owns it:

- **`util/Postcodes.java`** (new) — the postcode domain rules: the 4-digit format check and the region→range table with `isAllowedForRegion`. It knows *regions*, not cities, so it composes with the existing `CityLocality` (city→region) rather than duplicating it.
- **`rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerPostcode.java`** (new) — a single-responsibility pipeline step that orchestrates: skip when absent (backward-compatible), reject bad format, resolve region via `CityLocality`, reject out-of-range. Mirrors the existing `NormalizeOwnerEmail`/`ValidateOwnerFields` style.
- **`InvalidPostcodeException` + `InvalidPostcodeExceptionHandler`** (new) — a checked escalation → 400, built with the shared `ProblemDetails`, exactly like `InvalidEmailException`.
- **Wiring**: escalation YAML for the exception; inserted the `validatePostcode` step into both `owners.POST.yml` and `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` (right after field validation); `ApplyOwner` now copies `postcode` on update.
- **Persistence & contract**: added `postcode` to the `OwnerFields` OpenAPI schema (so it flows into both request and response DTOs via MapStruct automatically), a `postcode` field/accessors on the `Owner` entity, and the `postcode` column to all four DB schemas (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres).

No class became a catch-all — format/range logic sits in `Postcodes`, city→region stays in `CityLocality`, and the pipeline step just wires them together.
